## 0.1 Calendar helpers

```{r calendar}
# Quarter index: 2017Q1 = 1
qid <- function(year, q) (year - 2017) * 4 + q
q_label <- function(id) paste0(2017 + (id - 1) %/% 4, "Q", (id - 1) %% 4 + 1)

quarters <- expand_grid(year = 2017:2025, q = 1:4) %>%
  mutate(
    t = qid(year, q),
    start = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, (q - 1) * 3 + 1)),
    end = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year + (q == 4), ifelse(q == 4, 1, q * 3 + 1))) - 1,
    days = as.numeric(end - start) + 1
  )

T_SHORT  <- qid(2022, 4)   # shortage start (FDA announcement, Oct 2022)
T_END    <- qid(2023, 4)   # last quarter with national ARCOS supply below trend (see feasibility block)
T_REC24  <- qid(2024, 1)   # supply back at/above trend in ARCOS
T_DEA    <- qid(2024, 4)   # first amphetamine-class APQ increase (89 FR 72424, 5 Sep 2024)
T_LAST   <- qid(2024, 4)   # last quarter with FARS data
```

## 0.2 States and population (Census)

```{r population}
pop_v2020 <- read_csv("raw/census/SC-EST2020-ALLDATA5.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040", SEX == 0, ORIGIN == 0) %>%
  select(STATE, NAME, AGE, POPESTIMATE2017:POPESTIMATE2019)

pop_v2025 <- read_csv("raw/census/sc-est2025-alldata5.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040", SEX == 0, ORIGIN == 0) %>%
  select(STATE, NAME, AGE, POPESTIMATE2020:POPESTIMATE2025)

pop_long <- pop_v2020 %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("POPEST"), names_to = "year", values_to = "pop") %>%
  bind_rows(pop_v2025 %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("POPEST"), names_to = "year", values_to = "pop")) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_sub(year, -4)), fips = as.integer(STATE))

pop <- pop_long %>%
  mutate(agegrp = case_when(
    AGE >= 18 & AGE <= 44 ~ "p18_44",
    AGE >= 55 & AGE <= 74 ~ "p55_74",
    AGE >= 75             ~ "p75plus"
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(agegrp)) %>%
  group_by(fips, NAME, year, agegrp) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%   # sums the 5 race groups
  pivot_wider(names_from = agegrp, values_from = pop)

states <- pop %>% distinct(fips, NAME) %>%
  mutate(STATE_UP = toupper(NAME))

stopifnot(nrow(states) == 51)
```

## 0.3 Stimulant supply (DEA ARCOS Report 2 -> DDD per 1,000 residents 18-44 per day)

```{r arcos}
# Report 2 grams (parsed from the PDFs by scripts/parse_arcos.py)
arcos_raw <- read_csv("raw/arcos/arcos_report2_parsed.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# WHO ATC/DDD index (raw/who): amfetamine 15 mg, lisdexamfetamine 30 mg, methylphenidate 30 mg
ddd_mg <- c("1100" = 15, "1205" = 30, "1724" = 30)

arcos <- arcos_raw %>%
  filter(drug_code %in% c(1100, 1205, 1724)) %>%
  inner_join(states, by = c("state" = "STATE_UP")) %>%
  pivot_longer(q1:q4, names_to = "q", values_to = "grams") %>%
  mutate(q = as.integer(str_sub(q, 2)),
         ddd = grams * 1000 / ddd_mg[as.character(drug_code)],
         class = if_else(drug_code == 1724, "mph", "amph")) %>%
  group_by(fips, NAME, year, q, class) %>%
  summarise(grams = sum(grams), ddd = sum(ddd), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = c(grams, ddd)) %>%
  left_join(quarters, by = c("year", "q")) %>%
  left_join(pop %>% select(fips, year, p18_44), by = c("fips", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    amph_rate = ddd_amph / (p18_44 / 1000) / days,
    mph_rate  = ddd_mph  / (p18_44 / 1000) / days,
    all_rate  = (ddd_amph + ddd_mph) / (p18_44 / 1000) / days
  )

stopifnot(n_distinct(arcos$fips) == 51, nrow(arcos) == 51 * 36)
```

## 0.4 Shortage intensity per state (observed vs own pre-shortage trend)

```{r intensity}
# Expected supply = linear trend + quarter-of-year seasonality fitted to 2017Q1-2022Q3.
# Shortfall (%) = mean over the window of (expected - observed) / expected * 100.
shortfall <- function(df, var, window) {
  fit <- lm(reformulate(c("t", "factor(q)"), var), data = filter(df, t < T_SHORT))
  df %>%
    filter(t %in% window) %>%
    mutate(exp = predict(fit, newdata = .)) %>%
    summarise(sf = mean((exp - .data[[var]]) / exp) * 100) %>%
    pull(sf)
}

W_MAIN   <- T_SHORT:T_END                  # 2022Q4-2023Q4 (measured shortage window)
W_TO_APQ <- T_SHORT:(T_DEA - 1)            # 2022Q4-2024Q3 (up to the APQ increase)
W_LATEST <- T_SHORT:qid(2025, 4)           # 2022Q4-2025Q4 (shortage to latest ARCOS, as specified)

intensity <- arcos %>%
  group_by(fips, NAME) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(
    amph_sf_main   = shortfall(.x, "amph_rate", W_MAIN),
    amph_sf_latest = shortfall(.x, "amph_rate", W_LATEST),
    net_sf_main    = shortfall(.x, "all_rate",  W_MAIN),
    amph_sf_to_apq = shortfall(.x, "amph_rate", W_TO_APQ),
    # noise benchmark: same method, fake window 2021Q4-2022Q3, trend fitted on 2017Q1-2021Q3
    amph_sf_fake   = { fit <- lm(amph_rate ~ t + factor(q), data = filter(.x, t < qid(2021, 4)))
                       d <- filter(.x, t %in% qid(2021, 4):qid(2022, 3))
                       mean((predict(fit, d) - d$amph_rate) / predict(fit, d)) * 100 },
    # no-extrapolation alternative: % fall in supply vs 2022Q1-Q3 level
    amph_chg_main  = (1 - mean(.x$amph_rate[.x$t %in% W_MAIN]) / mean(.x$amph_rate[.x$t %in% qid(2022, 1:3)])) * 100,
    base_amph_rate = mean(.x$amph_rate[.x$t %in% qid(2022, 1:3)]),
    base_mph_rate  = mean(.x$mph_rate[.x$t %in% qid(2022, 1:3)])
  )) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## 0.5 Controls (VMT, unemployment, cannabis)

```{r controls}
# FHWA Highway Statistics VM-2: annual VMT (millions) by state, last column = total
read_vm2 <- function(y) {
  f <- list.files("raw/fhwa", pattern = paste0("vm2_", y), full.names = TRUE)
  x <- read_excel(f, sheet = "A", col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "minimal")
  hdr <- which(str_trim(as.character(x[[1]])) == "STATE")[1]          # header row
  tot <- max(which(str_trim(unlist(x[hdr, ])) == "TOTAL"))           # last 'TOTAL' = rural + urban
  tibble(NAME = str_trim(str_remove(as.character(x[[1]]), "\\(\\d\\)")),   # drop footnote marks
         vmt = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[[tot]])), year = y) %>%
    filter(NAME %in% states$NAME)
}
vmt <- map_dfr(2017:2024, read_vm2)
stopifnot(nrow(vmt) == 51 * 8)

# BLS LAUS state unemployment rate, monthly, via FRED (series <ST>UR)
st_abb <- c(state.abb, "DC"); st_name <- c(state.name, "District of Columbia")
unemp <- map_dfr(st_abb, function(a) {
  read_csv(file.path("raw/bls", paste0(a, "UR.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    set_names(c("date", "ur")) %>% mutate(NAME = st_name[st_abb == a])
}) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date), q = quarter(date)) %>%
  group_by(NAME, year, q) %>% summarise(unemp = mean(ur), .groups = "drop")

# Recreational cannabis effective dates (Wikipedia table, raw/cannabis)
cannabis <- read_csv("raw/cannabis/cannabis_recreational_legalization_wikipedia.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(NAME = recode(Jurisdiction, "Washington (state)" = "Washington", "Washington, D.C." = "District of Columbia"),
            rec_date = mdy(str_remove_all(`Effective date`, "\\[.*?\\]"))) %>%
  filter(NAME %in% states$NAME)
```

## 0.6 FARS: driver-level file, 2017-2024

```{r fars-read}
amph_names <- c("AMPHETAMINE", "AMPHETAMINE SULFATE", "DEXTROAMPHETAMINE")
meth_names <- c("METHAMPHETAMINE")
mph_names  <- c("METHYLPHENIDATE")
untested   <- "NOT GIVEN|NOT REPORTED|UNKNOWN IF TESTED"

ffile <- function(y, name) {
  f <- list.files(file.path("raw/fars/x", y), recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  f[tolower(basename(f)) == paste0(name, ".csv")]
}
rd <- function(f, cols) fread(f, select = cols, encoding = "Latin-1")

read_fars <- function(y) {
  acc <- rd(ffile(y, "accident"), c("STATE", "ST_CASE", "MONTH", "HOUR", "VE_FORMS", "FATALS"))
  per <- rd(ffile(y, "person"), c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "PER_NO", "PER_TYP", "AGE", "INJ_SEV", "ALC_RES"))
  veh <- rd(ffile(y, "vehicle"), c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "SPEEDREL", if (y < 2020) paste0("DR_SF", 1:4)))

  # drug results: one row per person x result
  if (y == 2017) {
    p17 <- rd(ffile(y, "person"), c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "PER_NO", paste0("DRUGRES", 1:3, "NAME")))
    drg <- melt(p17, id.vars = c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "PER_NO"), value.name = "DRUGRESNAME")
  } else {
    drg <- rd(ffile(y, "drugs"), c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "PER_NO", "DRUGRESNAME"))
  }
  drg[, nm := toupper(trimws(DRUGRESNAME))]
  drg <- drg[, .(amph = any(nm %in% amph_names), meth = any(nm %in% meth_names),
                 mph = any(nm %in% mph_names), tested = any(!grepl(untested, nm) & nm != "")),
             by = .(ST_CASE, VEH_NO, PER_NO)]

  # driver-related factors (any factor recorded, excluding 'none' 0 and unknown 99)
  if (y < 2020) {
    rf <- melt(veh[, c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", paste0("DR_SF", 1:4)), with = FALSE],
               id.vars = c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO"), value.name = "rf")
  } else {
    rf <- rd(ffile(y, "driverrf"), c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "DRIVERRF"))
    setnames(rf, "DRIVERRF", "rf")
  }
  rf <- rf[, .(fault = any(rf > 0 & rf < 99)), by = .(ST_CASE, VEH_NO)]

  drv <- per[PER_TYP == 1 & VEH_NO > 0]
  drv <- merge(drv, veh[, .(ST_CASE, VEH_NO, SPEEDREL)], by = c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO"), all.x = TRUE)
  drv <- merge(drv, rf, by = c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO"), all.x = TRUE)
  drv <- merge(drv, drg, by = c("ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "PER_NO"), all.x = TRUE)
  drv <- merge(drv, acc, by = "ST_CASE")

  peds_killed <- per[PER_TYP == 5 & INJ_SEV == 4, .(ped_deaths = .N), by = ST_CASE]
  acc <- merge(acc, peds_killed, by = "ST_CASE", all.x = TRUE)

  list(drv = drv[, year := y], acc = acc[, year := y])
}

fars <- map(2017:2024, read_fars)
drivers <- rbindlist(map(fars, "drv"), fill = TRUE)
crashes <- rbindlist(map(fars, "acc"), fill = TRUE)
crashes[is.na(ped_deaths), ped_deaths := 0]
```

```{r fars-flags}
drivers[, `:=`(
  q        = ceiling(MONTH / 3),
  age_ok   = AGE < 998,
  g_young  = AGE >= 18 & AGE <= 44,
  g_old    = AGE >= 55 & AGE <= 74,
  g_75     = AGE >= 75 & AGE < 998,
  speeding = SPEEDREL %in% 2:5,
  alcohol  = ALC_RES >= 80 & ALC_RES <= 940,
  fault    = fault %in% TRUE,
  amph     = amph %in% TRUE, meth = meth %in% TRUE, mph = mph %in% TRUE,
  tested   = tested %in% TRUE
)]
drivers[, amph_rx := amph & !meth]   # amphetamine without methamphetamine (meth metabolises to amphetamine)
```

## 0.7 FARS: crash counts by state x quarter x driver age group

```{r fars-aggregate}
# A crash counts for an age group if >= 1 driver in that group; subtype flags refer to that group's driver(s)
crash_counts <- function(gvar) {
  d <- drivers[get(gvar) == TRUE]
  cr <- d[, .(
    speeding = any(speeding), alcohol = any(alcohol), fault = any(fault),
    amph_rx = any(amph_rx), meth = any(meth), mph = any(mph), tested = any(tested)
  ), by = .(ST_CASE, year, STATE, q, VE_FORMS, HOUR, FATALS)]
  cr <- merge(cr, crashes[, .(ST_CASE, year, ped_deaths)], by = c("ST_CASE", "year"))
  cr[, .(
    crashes    = .N,
    deaths     = sum(FATALS),
    single_veh = sum(VE_FORMS == 1),
    multi_veh  = sum(VE_FORMS > 1),
    daytime    = sum(HOUR >= 6 & HOUR <= 17),
    nighttime  = sum(HOUR < 6 | (HOUR >= 18 & HOUR <= 23)),
    fault      = sum(fault),
    speeding   = sum(speeding),
    alcohol    = sum(alcohol),
    amph_rx    = sum(amph_rx),
    meth       = sum(meth),
    mph        = sum(mph),
    tested     = sum(tested),
    ped_deaths = sum(ped_deaths)
  ), by = .(fips = STATE, year, q)][, group := gvar]
}

counts <- rbindlist(map(c("g_young", "g_old", "g_75"), crash_counts)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(group = recode(group, g_young = "18-44", g_old = "55-74", g_75 = "75+"))

# Complete panel (zeros where no crash), attach population, controls, exposure
panel <- expand_grid(fips = states$fips, year = 2017:2024, q = 1:4, group = c("18-44", "55-74", "75+")) %>%
  left_join(counts, by = c("fips", "year", "q", "group")) %>%
  mutate(across(crashes:ped_deaths, ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  left_join(states %>% select(fips, NAME), by = "fips") %>%
  left_join(quarters %>% select(year, q, t, start, end), by = c("year", "q")) %>%
  left_join(pop %>% select(fips, year, p18_44, p55_74, p75plus), by = c("fips", "year")) %>%
  mutate(pop = case_when(group == "18-44" ~ p18_44, group == "55-74" ~ p55_74, TRUE ~ p75plus)) %>%
  left_join(vmt, by = c("NAME", "year")) %>%
  left_join(unemp, by = c("NAME", "year", "q")) %>%
  left_join(cannabis, by = "NAME") %>%
  left_join(intensity %>% select(fips, amph_sf_main, net_sf_main, amph_sf_latest, amph_sf_to_apq, amph_chg_main), by = "fips") %>%
  mutate(
    cannabis_legal = as.integer(!is.na(rec_date) & rec_date <= end),
    log_vmt = log(vmt),
    post    = as.integer(t >= T_SHORT & t <= T_END),   # shortage 2022Q4-2023Q4
    rec24   = as.integer(t >= T_REC24),                  # recovery 2024Q1-Q4 (ARCOS)
    rec_dea = as.integer(t >= T_DEA),                    # recovery 2024Q4 (DEA quota date)
    covid   = as.integer(t >= qid(2020, 1) & t <= qid(2021, 4)),
    young   = as.integer(group == "18-44"),
    I10     = amph_sf_main / 10,           # shortfall in units of 10 percentage points
    I10_net = net_sf_main / 10,
    state_group = paste(fips, group),
    t_group     = paste(t, group)
  ) %>%
  select(-p18_44, -p55_74, -p75plus)

stopifnot(nrow(panel) == 51 * 32 * 3, !anyNA(panel$pop), !anyNA(panel$vmt), !anyNA(panel$unemp))
young_panel <- filter(panel, group == "18-44")
```

## 0.10 Model helpers

```{r helpers}
# Poisson coefficient -> % change with 95% CI (state-clustered SEs)
pc <- function(m, term) {
  stopifnot(term %in% names(coef(m)))
  b <- unname(coef(m)[term]); s <- unname(se(m)[term])
  tibble(term = term, pct = 100 * (exp(b) - 1), lo = 100 * (exp(b - 1.96 * s) - 1),
         hi = 100 * (exp(b + 1.96 * s) - 1), p = unname(pvalue(m)[term]), n = nobs(m))
}
fmt <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f to %.1f), p=%.2f", x$pct, x$lo, x$hi, x$p)
ctrl <- "log_vmt + unemp + cannabis_legal"
pois <- function(f, data, offset = ~log(pop)) fepois(as.formula(f), data = data, offset = offset, cluster = ~fips)
qlab_breaks <- qid(2017:2024, 1)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
```

## 1.2 National supply vs trend

```{r feas-national}
nat_arcos <- arcos %>%
  group_by(t, year, q, days) %>%
  summarise(across(c(ddd_amph, ddd_mph, p18_44), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(amph_rate = ddd_amph / (p18_44 / 1000) / days,
         all_rate  = (ddd_amph + ddd_mph) / (p18_44 / 1000) / days)
fit_nat <- lm(amph_rate ~ t + factor(q), data = filter(nat_arcos, t < T_SHORT))
fit_all <- lm(all_rate ~ t + factor(q), data = filter(nat_arcos, t < T_SHORT))
nat_arcos <- nat_arcos %>%
  mutate(amph_exp = predict(fit_nat, .), all_exp = predict(fit_all, .),
         amph_gap = (amph_exp - amph_rate) / amph_exp * 100,
         net_gap  = (all_exp - all_rate) / all_exp * 100)
nat_arcos %>% filter(t >= qid(2022, 1)) %>%
  transmute(quarter = q_label(t), amph_rate = round(amph_rate, 1), expected = round(amph_exp, 1),
            shortfall_pct = round(amph_gap, 1), net_of_mph_pct = round(net_gap, 1))
```

## 1.3 Spread across states

```{r feas-spread}
spread <- intensity %>%
  summarise(across(c(amph_sf_main, net_sf_main, amph_sf_to_apq, amph_sf_latest, amph_chg_main, amph_sf_fake),
                   list(mean = mean, sd = sd, min = min, max = max))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("measure", "stat"), names_pattern = "(.*)_(mean|sd|min|max)") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(cv = sd / abs(mean))
spread
cor_fake <- cor(intensity$amph_sf_main, intensity$amph_sf_fake)
cor_fake
# Rule: CV < 0.1 -> no usable dose-response. CV here is far above 0.1, so the state design is kept,
# but the fake-window benchmark shows much of the spread is trend-extrapolation noise (see decisions_log).
```

## 1.4 Supply-recovery date (Federal Register, GPO copies in raw/fedreg)

```{r feas-recovery}
fr_line <- function(doc, pattern) {
  x <- readLines(file.path("raw/fedreg", paste0("fr_", doc, ".htm")), warn = FALSE)
  x <- str_squish(str_remove_all(x, "<[^>]*>"))
  x[str_detect(x, regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
}
recovery <- tribble(
  ~document,    ~citation,      ~published,   ~pattern,
  "2023-22059", "88 FR 68147",  "2023-10-03", "^Methylphenidate \\(for sale\\)\\.{3,}",
  "2024-20114", "89 FR 72424",  "2024-09-05", "^lisdexamfetamine\\.{3,}",
  "2024-20114", "89 FR 72424",  "2024-09-05", "^d-amphetamine \\(for conversion\\)\\.{3,}",
  "2025-19335", "90 FR 47825",  "2025-10-02", "^d-amphetamine \\(for sale\\)\\.{3,}",
  "2026-22842", "91 FR 72564",  "2026-11-10", "^d,l-amphetamine\\.{3,}"
) %>%
  mutate(line = map2_chr(document, pattern, fr_line),
         old_apq_g = as.numeric(str_remove_all(str_extract(line, "[\\d,]{6,}"), ",")),
         new_apq_g = as.numeric(str_remove_all(str_extract(line, "[\\d,]{6,}$"), ",")),
         pct_increase = round((new_apq_g / old_apq_g - 1) * 100, 1)) %>%
  select(-pattern)
recovery
```

# 2. NATIONAL COMPARISON: drivers 18-44 vs 55-74
# =====================================================================

## 2.1 Data prep

```{r nat-prep}
nat_df <- panel %>% filter(group %in% c("18-44", "55-74"))
nat_nocovid <- filter(nat_df, covid == 0)
```

## 2.2 Difference-in-differences

```{r nat-did}
m_nat      <- pois("crashes ~ young:post + young:rec24 | state_group + t", nat_nocovid)
m_nat_cov  <- pois("crashes ~ young:post + young:rec24 + young:covid | state_group + t", nat_df)   # COVID dummies instead
m_nat_dth  <- pois("deaths ~ young:post + young:rec24 | state_group + t", nat_nocovid)
nat_res <- bind_rows(
  pc(m_nat, "young:post") %>% mutate(model = "Crashes, COVID quarters excluded"),
  pc(m_nat, "young:rec24") %>% mutate(model = "Crashes, COVID quarters excluded"),
  pc(m_nat_cov, "young:post") %>% mutate(model = "Crashes, young x COVID dummy"),
  pc(m_nat_dth, "young:post") %>% mutate(model = "Deaths, COVID quarters excluded"),
  pc(m_nat_dth, "young:rec24") %>% mutate(model = "Deaths, COVID quarters excluded"),
  pc(pois("crashes ~ young:post + young:rec24 | state_group^q + t", nat_nocovid), "young:post") %>% mutate(model = "Crashes, state x age x season FE")
)
nat_res
```

## 2.3 Event study

```{r nat-es}
# state_group^q = state x age-group x quarter-of-year FE (age groups differ in crash seasonality)
# With state x season FE one reference quarter per season is needed: the 4 quarters before the shortage
REF_T <- (T_SHORT - 4):(T_SHORT - 1)                 # 2021Q4-2022Q3
REFS  <- paste0("c(", paste(REF_T, collapse = ","), ")")
# National model drops COVID quarters (incl. 2021Q4), so its season-4 reference is 2019Q4
REF_T_NAT <- c(qid(2019, 4), qid(2022, 1:3))
REFS_NAT  <- paste0("c(", paste(REF_T_NAT, collapse = ","), ")")
m_nat_es <- pois(paste0("crashes ~ i(t, young, ref = ", REFS_NAT, ") | state_group^q + t"), nat_nocovid)
m_nat_es_raw <- pois(sprintf("crashes ~ i(t, young, ref = %d) | state_group + t", T_SHORT - 1), nat_nocovid)
es_tidy <- function(m, pattern, refs = REF_T) {
  ct <- coeftable(m)
  tibble(term = rownames(ct), b = ct[, 1], s = ct[, 2]) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, pattern)) %>%
    mutate(t = as.integer(str_extract(term, "(?<=t::)\\d+")),
           pct = 100 * (exp(b) - 1), lo = 100 * (exp(b - 1.96 * s) - 1), hi = 100 * (exp(b + 1.96 * s) - 1)) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(t = refs, pct = 0, lo = 0, hi = 0))
}
es_plot <- function(d, title, ylab) {
  ggplot(d, aes(t, pct)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = T_SHORT - 0.5, xmax = T_END + 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.12, fill = "red") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 0.25) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = qlab_breaks, labels = 2017:2024) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab, caption = "Reference: one pre-shortage quarter per season (2021Q4-2022Q3; national model 2019Q4, 2022Q1-Q3). 95% CIs, SEs clustered by state.")
}
es_nat <- es_tidy(m_nat_es, "young", REF_T_NAT)
lead_keep <- function(v, refs = REF_T) paste0("^t::(", paste(setdiff(1:(T_SHORT - 1), refs), collapse = "|"), "):", v, "$")   # all non-reference leads
pre_test_nat <- wald(m_nat_es, keep = lead_keep("young", REF_T_NAT), print = FALSE)
pre_test_nat_raw <- wald(m_nat_es_raw, keep = paste0("^t::(", paste(1:(T_SHORT - 2), collapse = "|"), "):young$"), print = FALSE)
pre_test_nat; pre_test_nat_raw
p_es_nat <- es_plot(es_nat, "A. National: drivers 18-44 vs 55-74 (COVID quarters excluded; state x age x season FE)", "% difference vs reference quarters")
p_es_nat
```

# =====================================================================
# 3. MAIN DESIGN: dose-response by state
# =====================================================================

## 3.1 Main model

```{r dose-main}
m_dose     <- pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_panel)
m_dose_vmt <- pois("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 + unemp + cannabis_legal | fips + t", young_panel, offset = ~log(vmt / 4))
m_dose_dth <- pois(paste("deaths ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_panel)
etable(m_dose, m_dose_vmt, m_dose_dth)
dose_main <- pc(m_dose, "I10:post")
fmt(dose_main)
```

## 3.2 Event study (leads and lags)

```{r dose-es}
# fips^q = state x quarter-of-year FE: high-shortfall states (e.g. FL, TX, CA) have different crash seasonality
m_dose_es <- pois(paste0("crashes ~ i(t, I10, ref = ", REFS, ") + ", ctrl, " | fips^q + t"), young_panel)
m_dose_es_raw <- pois(sprintf("crashes ~ i(t, I10, ref = %d) + %s | fips + t", T_SHORT - 1, ctrl), young_panel)
es_dose <- es_tidy(m_dose_es, "I10")
pre_test_dose <- wald(m_dose_es, keep = lead_keep("I10"), print = FALSE)
pre_test_dose_raw <- wald(m_dose_es_raw, keep = paste0("^t::(", paste(1:(T_SHORT - 2), collapse = "|"), "):I10$"), print = FALSE)
pre_test_dose; pre_test_dose_raw
p_es_dose <- es_plot(es_dose, "B. Dose-response: per 10 pp state supply shortfall, drivers 18-44 (state x season FE)", "% change per 10 pp (vs reference)")
p_es_dose
```

## 3.3 Robustness

```{r dose-robust}
can_states <- cannabis %>% filter(rec_date >= as.Date("2022-01-01"), rec_date <= as.Date("2024-12-31")) %>% pull(NAME)
dose_rob <- bind_rows(
  pc(m_dose, "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "Main"),
  pc(m_dose_vmt, "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "Rate per VMT (offset)"),
  pc(m_dose_dth, "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "Deaths instead of crashes"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I10_net:post + I10_net:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_panel), "I10_net:post") %>% mutate(spec = "Net of methylphenidate substitution"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I(amph_sf_to_apq/10):post +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_panel %>% mutate(post = as.integer(t >= T_SHORT & t < T_DEA))),
     "I(amph_sf_to_apq/10):post") %>% mutate(spec = "Intensity and post to APQ increase (2022Q4-2024Q3)"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I(amph_sf_latest/10):post +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_panel %>% mutate(post = as.integer(t >= T_SHORT))),
     "I(amph_sf_latest/10):post") %>% mutate(spec = "Intensity to latest ARCOS (2022Q4-2025Q4), post = 2022Q4-2024Q4"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I(amph_chg_main/10):post + I(amph_chg_main/10):rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_panel),
     "I(amph_chg_main/10):post") %>% mutate(spec = "No-extrapolation intensity (fall vs 2022Q1-Q3)"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), filter(young_panel, covid == 0)), "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "COVID quarters excluded"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips[t] + t"), young_panel), "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "State-specific linear trends"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), filter(young_panel, !NAME %in% can_states)), "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "Excluding states legalising cannabis 2022-2024"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), filter(young_panel, year != 2022)), "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "Excluding 2022 (telehealth collapse)"),
  pc(pois("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 | fips + t", young_panel), "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "No controls"),
  pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips^q + t"), young_panel), "I10:post") %>% mutate(spec = "State x season fixed effects")
)
dose_rob %>% mutate(across(pct:hi, ~ round(.x, 1)), p = round(p, 3))
```

# =====================================================================
# 5. REVERSAL: did crashes fall again where supply recovered?
# =====================================================================

```{r reversal}
# (a) ARCOS recovery: 2024Q1-Q4 vs shortage; (b) DEA quota date: 2024Q4 only, with 2024Q1-Q3 separate
m_rev_dea <- pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:post + I10:mid24 + I10:rec_dea +", ctrl, "| fips + t"),
                  young_panel %>% mutate(mid24 = as.integer(t >= T_REC24 & t < T_DEA)))
rev_res <- bind_rows(
  pc(m_dose, "I10:post") %>% mutate(model = "Shortage 2022Q4-2023Q4"),
  pc(m_dose, "I10:rec24") %>% mutate(model = "Recovery 2024 (ARCOS)"),
  pc(m_rev_dea, "I10:rec_dea") %>% mutate(model = "Recovery 2024Q4 (DEA quota date)"),
  pc(m_ddd, "I10:young:rec24") %>% mutate(model = "Triple difference, recovery 2024")
)
rev_test <- wald(m_dose, keep = "I10:post|I10:rec24", print = FALSE)   # joint
rev_diff <- { b <- coef(m_dose); V <- vcov(m_dose)
  d <- b["I10:rec24"] - b["I10:post"]; s <- sqrt(V["I10:rec24", "I10:rec24"] + V["I10:post", "I10:post"] - 2 * V["I10:rec24", "I10:post"])
  tibble(diff_logpoints = d, se = s, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(d / s))) }
rev_res; rev_diff
```

# =====================================================================
# 6. MECHANISM: which crash types move?
# =====================================================================

```{r mechanism}
mech_outcomes <- c(crashes = "All crashes", single_veh = "Single-vehicle", multi_veh = "Multi-vehicle",
                   daytime = "Daytime (06-17h)", nighttime = "Night (18-05h)", fault = "Driver error recorded",
                   speeding = "Speeding-related", alcohol = "Driver BAC >= 0.08",
                   amph_rx = "Driver amphetamine+ (no meth)", meth = "Driver methamphetamine+", tested = "Driver drug-tested")
mech <- map_dfr(names(mech_outcomes), function(y) {
  bind_rows(
    pc(pois(paste(y, "~ young:post + young:rec24 | state_group + t"), nat_nocovid), "young:post") %>% mutate(design = "National 18-44 vs 55-74"),
    pc(pois(paste(y, "~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_panel), "I10:post") %>% mutate(design = "Dose-response (per 10 pp)")
  ) %>% mutate(outcome = mech_outcomes[[y]])
})
# Drug results as share of drug-tested drivers (offset = tested crashes), to separate drug findings from testing changes
young_tested <- filter(young_panel, tested > 0)
nat_tested   <- filter(nat_nocovid, tested > 0)
drug_share <- map_dfr(c(amph_rx = "Amphetamine+ (no meth) per tested", meth = "Methamphetamine+ per tested") %>% imap(~ c(.y, .x)), function(v) {
  bind_rows(
    pc(pois(paste(v[1], "~ young:post + young:rec24 | state_group + t"), nat_tested, offset = ~log(tested)), "young:post") %>% mutate(design = "National 18-44 vs 55-74"),
    pc(pois(paste(v[1], "~ I10:post + I10:rec24 +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), young_tested, offset = ~log(tested)), "I10:post") %>% mutate(design = "Dose-response (per 10 pp)")
  ) %>% mutate(outcome = v[2])
})
drug_share %>% mutate(across(pct:hi, ~ round(.x, 1)), p = round(p, 3))

# Is the amphetamine+ finding a pre-existing pattern? Same model with fake shortage dates (pre-shortage data only)
amph_placebo <- map_dfr(list(c(qid(2019, 4), qid(2020, 4)), c(qid(2021, 4), qid(2022, 3))), function(w) {
  d <- filter(young_panel, t <= w[2]) %>% mutate(fake = as.integer(t >= w[1]))
  bind_rows(
    pc(pois(paste("amph_rx ~ I10:fake +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), d), "I10:fake") %>% mutate(outcome = "Amphetamine+ (count)"),
    pc(pois(paste("amph_rx ~ I10:fake +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), filter(d, tested > 0), offset = ~log(tested)), "I10:fake") %>% mutate(outcome = "Amphetamine+ per tested")
  ) %>% mutate(placebo_start = q_label(w[1]))
})
amph_placebo %>% mutate(across(pct:hi, ~ round(.x, 1)), p = round(p, 3))
mech %>% mutate(across(pct:hi, ~ round(.x, 1)), p = round(p, 3))
mech_counts <- young_panel %>% summarise(across(all_of(names(mech_outcomes)), sum))
mech_counts

p_mech <- mech %>% mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, rev(unname(mech_outcomes)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(pct, outcome)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~design, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "% change during shortage (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = "Mechanism: change in crash types involving drivers 18-44, 2022Q4-2023Q4",
       caption = "Drug-test outcomes: testing is incomplete and varies by state; state fixed effects keep comparisons within state.")
ggsave("figures/05_mechanism_panel.png", p_mech, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
p_mech
```

```{r placebo-dates}
plac_date <- function(t0, t1, label) {   # (names avoid masking by the panel's start/end date columns)
  d  <- filter(young_panel, t <= t1) %>% mutate(fake = as.integer(t >= t0))
  dn <- filter(nat_df, t <= t1, covid == 0 | t >= t0) %>% mutate(fake = as.integer(t >= t0))
  bind_rows(
    pc(pois(paste("crashes ~ I10:fake +", ctrl, "| fips + t"), d), "I10:fake") %>% mutate(design = "Dose-response"),
    pc(pois("crashes ~ young:fake | state_group + t", dn), "young:fake") %>% mutate(design = "National 18-44 vs 55-74")
  ) %>% mutate(placebo = label)
}
plac_dates <- bind_rows(
  plac_date(qid(2019, 4), qid(2020, 4), "Shortage 'starts' 2019Q4 (data to 2020Q4)"),

)
```

# =====================================================================
# 9. EXCESS CRASHES AND DEATHS ATTRIBUTABLE TO THE SHORTAGE
# =====================================================================

```{r excess}
excess_dose <- function(m, var) {
  b <- coef(m)["I10:post"]; s <- se(m)["I10:post"]
  d <- young_panel %>% filter(post == 1)
  map_dfr(c(est = b, lo = b - 1.96 * s, hi = b + 1.96 * s), function(bb)
    tibble(x = sum(d[[var]] * (1 - exp(-bb * d$I10))))) %>% mutate(bound = c("est", "lo", "hi"))
}
excess_nat <- function(m, var) {
  b <- coef(m)["young:post"]; s <- se(m)["young:post"]
  obs <- young_panel %>% filter(post == 1) %>% pull(var) %>% sum()
  tibble(x = obs * (1 - exp(-c(b, b - 1.96 * s, b + 1.96 * s))), bound = c("est", "lo", "hi"))
}
excess <- bind_rows(
  excess_dose(m_dose, "crashes") %>% mutate(design = "Dose-response", outcome = "crashes"),
  excess_dose(m_dose_dth, "deaths") %>% mutate(design = "Dose-response", outcome = "deaths"),
  excess_nat(m_nat, "crashes") %>% mutate(design = "National 18-44 vs 55-74", outcome = "crashes"),
  excess_nat(m_nat_dth, "deaths") %>% mutate(design = "National 18-44 vs 55-74", outcome = "deaths")
) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = bound, values_from = x)
shortage_totals <- young_panel %>% filter(post == 1) %>% summarise(crashes = sum(crashes), deaths = sum(deaths))
excess; shortage_totals
```

```{r save-results}
results <- list(nat_res = nat_res, es_nat = es_nat, dose_rob = dose_rob, es_dose = es_dose, ddd_res = ddd_res,
                es_ddd = es_ddd, rev_res = rev_res, mech = mech, drug_share = drug_share, amph_placebo = amph_placebo, sec_res = sec_res, plac_out = plac_out,
                plac_dates = plac_dates, excess = excess, spread = spread, recovery = recovery,
                nat_arcos = nat_arcos, scatter = scatter_df)
wb <- loadWorkbook("clean_data.xlsx")
for (nm in names(results)) { if (nm %in% names(wb)) removeWorksheet(wb, nm); addWorksheet(wb, nm); writeData(wb, nm, as.data.frame(lapply(results[[nm]], unname))) }
saveWorkbook(wb, "clean_data.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
saveRDS(list(results = results, pre = list(nat = pre_test_nat, nat_raw = pre_test_nat_raw, dose = pre_test_dose, dose_raw = pre_test_dose_raw, ddd = pre_test_ddd),
             rev_diff = rev_diff, cor_fake = cor_fake, mech_counts = mech_counts, shortage_totals = shortage_totals),
        "results.rds")
```
